text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly simulates future land use/land cover (LULC) changes at the national scale of Bangladesh from 2010 to 2030. It implements three distinct future scenarios—baseline, ecological protection priority, and economic growth—and quantitatively compares projected land use demands and spatial patterns across these scenarios. The study uses the Dynamics of Land Systems (DLS) model with spatially explicit 1 km resolution data, incorporates 11 driving factors across geophysical, climatic, proximity, and socioeconomic categories, and validates model performance using the Kappa coefficient (Kappa = 0.667). Outputs include mapped projections of six land use classes and tabulated area changes with percentage shifts under each scenario. All core inclusion criteria are met: national-scale focus, primary objective is LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios with quantitative comparison, spatial modeling with accuracy metrics, and mapped LULC projections. None of the exclusion criteria apply.)
